# 문제 3

```jsx
function ProductCard({ title, price, location, image }) {
  return (
    <article className="product-card">
      <img className="product-card__image" src={image} alt={title} />
      <h4>{title}</h4>
      <p className="product-card__location">{location}</p>
      <p className="product-card__price">{price.toLocaleString()}원</p>
    </article>
  );
}

function App() {
  return (
    <main>
      <h2>인기 매물</h2>
      <div className="product-list">
        <ProductCard title="아이패드 에어" price={650000} location="역삼동"
          image="https://picsum.photos/seed/ipad/300/200" />
        <ProductCard title="캠핑용 의자" price={35000} location="서초동"
          image="https://picsum.photos/seed/chair/300/200" />
        <ProductCard title="기계식 키보드" price={89000} location="양재동"
          image="https://picsum.photos/seed/keyboard/300/200" />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

export default App;
```

# 문제 5

```jsx
import { useState } from "react";

function LikeButton() {
  const [likes, setLikes] = useState(0);

  function handleClick() {
    setLikes(likes + 1);
  }

  return <button onClick={handleClick}>좋아요 {likes}</button>;
}

function App() {
  return <LikeButton />;
}

export default App;
```

# 문제 7

```jsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

function Clock() {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(new Date());

  useEffect(() => {
    const timerId = setInterval(() => setNow(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timerId);
  }, []);

  return <time>{now.toLocaleTimeString("ko-KR")}</time>;
}

function App() {
  return <Clock />;
}

export default App;
```

# 문제 8

```jsx
import { useRef } from "react";

function SearchBox() {
  const inputRef = useRef(null);

  function handleFocus() {
    inputRef.current.focus();
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <input ref={inputRef} placeholder="검색어" />
      <button type="button" onClick={handleFocus}>검색창으로 이동</button>
    </div>
  );
}

function App() {
  return <SearchBox />;
}

export default App;
```

```jsx
import "./App.css";

const posts = [
  { id: "p1", username: "minjun_dev", caption: "오늘은 React를 공부했습니다." },
  { id: "p2", username: "coding_kim", caption: "배열 데이터를 화면에 표시합니다." },
  { id: "p3", username: "web_lee", caption: "반복되는 카드를 재사용합니다." },
];

function PostCard({ post }) {
  return (
    <article className="post-card">
      <h3>{post.username}</h3>
      <p>{post.caption}</p>
    </article>
  );
}

function App() {
  return (
    <main>
      <h1>게시물</h1>
      <section>
        {posts.map((post) => (
          <PostCard key={post.id} post={post} />
        ))}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

export default App;
```

# 문제 10

```jsx
import "./App.css";
import { useState } from "react";

const posts = [
  { id: "p1", username: "minjun_dev", caption: "오늘은 React를 공부했습니다." },
  { id: "p2", username: "coding_kim", caption: "배열 데이터를 화면에 표시합니다." },
  { id: "p3", username: "web_lee", caption: "React 프로젝트를 완성했습니다." },
];

function PostCard({ post }) {
  return (
    <article className="post-card">
      <h2>{post.username}</h2>
      <p>{post.caption}</p>
    </article>
  );
}

function App() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const visiblePosts = posts.filter((post) =>
    post.caption.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)
  );

  return (
    <main>
      <h1>게시물 검색</h1>
      <label htmlFor="post-search">검색어</label>
      <input
        id="post-search"
        type="search"
        value={query}
        onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
        placeholder="예: React"
      />

      <p role="status">검색 결과 {visiblePosts.length}개</p>
      {visiblePosts.length === 0 ? (
        <p>검색 결과가 없습니다.</p>
      ) : (
        <section>
          {visiblePosts.map((post) => (
            <PostCard key={post.id} post={post} />
          ))}
        </section>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

export default App;
```
